context.transcript:
What topics should we cover in the next staff meeting?
A. We should talk about the new payroll procedures.
B. Yes, I think it went well today.
C. Either in the auditorium or the lobby.

B. 是的，我想今天过得不错。
C. 要么在礼堂要么在大厅。
